name: t7_wide_bent
idea: t1's idea done again: the free foot 5 px out (feet about 29 px apart, the top of FG-P15's demure range), the heel lifted so the knee bends (a spread heel on the ground straightens the IK leg: t1 bent 2 deg), the glaive butt only 5 px out so the grip arm keeps its bend
verdict: KEPT, HERO (#1, 13/13, gap 378 px2, width 97, feet 29): the near foot steps 5 px out with its heel lifted and knee bent (10-30 deg), the butt 5 px out; at x3 and 1x the legs stop reading as two columns and the pose steps toward the staff, inside DESIGN 1's 20-30 px demure stance. The first try (heel height 10) bent the knee 32 deg (FG-P10) [M; visible]
